verdict.rationale: Grounding public claims in government data is a fair axis for an immigration-services provider, but the evidence shows none of it. The 98.5% approval rate is published as a bare number with no case-count basis, time window, or source. The resource guides (F-1/J-1 to O-1, references, RFE handling) give practical advice but show no USCIS processing data, FOIA statistics, or linked official policy citations.
